crashLines: Rickshaw bhaiya said "Meter se chalega!" Too late.
Auto uncle did a perfect U-turn... right into you.
The bus never read the brakes manual.
Bus horn louder than your scream!
Scooter uncle with 4 family members said hello.
Triple seat scooter! Traffic rules not included.
Cycle ki ghanti: tring tring... BOOM.
The milkman's cycle with 12 cans got you.
The fruit thela wins this round.
Gau mata has right of way. Always.
The cow stared. You blinked. Cow wins.
The baraat band drowned out your scream.
You joined the wedding dance... involuntarily.
